items.q: What should you remember about **Smart zone ~100K**?
items.a: **1M context windows mostly add** more dumb zone; retrieval OK, coding not; status line essential (aihero.dev article).

items.q: What should you remember about **Session anatomy**?
items.a: **system prompt (keep tiny) →** explore → implement → test; clearing beats compacting for predictable resets.

items.q: What should you remember about **Grill Me live**?
items.a: **sub-agent explore burns ~94K in isolation; parent** stays lean; 22–100+ alignment questions; shared design concept (Brooks, *Design of Design*) beats reading plans.

items.q: What should you remember about **Don't read the PRD**?
items.a: **after grilling you're testing** summarization only; Matt skips review intentionally.

items.q: What should you remember about **Vertical slices**?
items.a: **AI codes horizontally (DB → API → UI);** tracer bullets give feedback before phase 3; first slice must span schema + service + minimal UI.

items.q: What should you remember about **Ralph AFK loop**?
items.a: **once.sh cats all issue markdown** + last 5 commits; permission accept-edits; human exits loop at implementation.

items.q: What should you remember about **TDD anti-cheat**?
items.a: **failing test first; separate review context** = smart zone reviewer; feedback loops are the ceiling on AI output quality.

items.q: What should you remember about **Deep modules**?
items.a: **Ousterhout *Philosophy of Software Design*; shallow modules** = untestable graph; design interfaces, delegate implementation (gray boxes) to retain codebase mental model.

items.q: What should you remember about **Sand Castle parallel**?
items.a: **Sonnet implementer + Opus reviewer;** worktrees in Docker; planner picks parallelizable issues from blocking graph.

items.q: What should you remember about **Doc rot**?
items.a: **closed PRDs mislead agents when** code diverges; prefer closing GitHub issues over keeping stale markdown.

items.q: What should you remember about **Frontend prototypes**?
items.a: **throwaway routes for 3 clickable UI** options; feed winner into grilling; Playwright/browser MCP not mature enough for taste QA.
